game_concept: A adventure race set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse, the frozen gate of the hold: the hold guard must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Pipeline: Chain one function's output into the next to push furs down a processing line.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse: the frozen gate of the hold
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Gatehouse, repeat each round: Chain one function's output into the next to push furs down a processing line. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the hold guard ahead. Then check the pipeline value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the frozen well by solving code steps involving pipeline that move the hold guard forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the frozen well first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Function Pipeline
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Function Pipeline' (Week 6 slot 5), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Frozen Gatehouse'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how pipeline changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Frozen Gatehouse.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
